## Pre-Practice Reminder

Giselle stresses the importance of wearing comfortable shoes before practice sessions. Proper footwear is essential, particularly when engaging in passing drills, allowing for better movement and stability. This recommendation underscores the need for athletes to select the right equipment as part of their pre-training preparation to enhance their training experience and safeguard their well-being.
